caption: The drawing depicts the interior of a wooden building, featuring several prominent vertical brown columns in the foreground, which extend from the floor to the ceiling. The floor and lower walls are composed of horizontal, light brown wooden planks. In the center background, there is an elevated platform with a wooden railing of vertical slats. On this platform sits a rectangular table draped with a white cloth, upon which rest two white candles and an additional object. Behind the table, there is a framed area resembling a painting or a stained glass window, showing abstract multicolored patterns. To the left of the platform is a round, white basin supported by a pedestal with wheels. To the right of the platform, there is a dark green cast-iron stove or heating unit, and in front of it, a simple wooden bench with curved legs. The ceiling is composed of angled wooden planks in a lighter beige tone, with visible structural beams painted in a darker shade. The overall color palette includes shades of brown, beige, white, green, and touches of muted colors in the wall art behind the platform.
title: Muskego Church
